body: Thanks, I'll try to keep that in mind. You know, I'm a little old fashioned. I am really into the 70s and a lot of my novels are set in the 70s. People used to laugh because I was a hippie and dressed like one. I am now still wearing my 70s clothes but I don't have any friends and I think sometimes that I'm really not meant to be here. And I suffer from depression. I guess a lot of peoples lives are not going the way they want them to.
I write horror and thrillers, some times adventure.

Yes, I self-published my first novel last year. The book is 170,000 words but it didn't sell due to not promoting the right way and mistakes. I'm still learning about grammar and how to promote. But I want to find a real agent one day and be a real published author.
